title: Fold Catch2 setup into SECTIONs
summary: Copied setup moves into one TEST_CASE with SECTIONs. Each section reruns the case from the top, so a follow-up test nests.

turns.user: moved to Catch2 v3, want to clean up the lru tests while at it. all 3 start with the same puts, merge them

assistant.body: Great timing. The shared setup goes at the top of one TEST_CASE and each test becomes a SECTION. The third one continues from the state the second leaves behind, with c already in, so I dropped its duplicate put("c", 3).

turns.user: only the 3rd fails. contains("b") is true and contains("c") is false

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous explanation was incorrect. Catch2 reruns the TEST_CASE from the top for every leaf section it runs. By the time the third section starts, the cache holds only a and b, so putting d evicts a and b stays. To carry state forward, nest the section inside the one it continues. The outer body runs again each time the inner one is entered.

turns.user: passes. can CI run just the lru ones?

assistant.body: Sure! Give the TEST_CASE a tag as its second argument, then pass "[lru]" to the test binary. Tags select tests by what they cover rather than by name, with no need to split files.
